chunks: When Our clear messages are read out to them you can see denial on the faces of unbelievers. They can hardly restrain themselves from attacking those who recite Our revelations. Tell them: "Should I give you news of something worse than this?" -- Hell, which God has promised the infidels. How evil a destination!
ai.seo_question: How do disbelievers react when Quran is recited to them?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Hajj, this verse vividly portrays the visceral hostility of the disbelievers, whose facial expressions betray their recognition of truth even as their anger drives them to nearly attack the Prophet and his companions. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a sign of the 'Fitrah' (innate disposition) being obscured by arrogance, contrasting their physical aggression with the spiritual reality of the message. The rhetorical conclusion serves as a divine warning that their ultimate fate in Hell is a more severe consequence than the temporal persecution they inflict.
